uncertainties.description: The map labels a vertical connection as 35A, while page 35 describes the trapdoor pit without a separate 35A heading. The node label and waypoint classification therefore combine the map label with that description.
The exact position and vertical profile of the entrance from 9 FOUNTAIN into 9A UNDERWATER TUNNEL are not stated in text; the map marks a concealed connection and the fountain pool is 30 feet deep.
The source states that 9A UNDERWATER TUNNEL connects to 44 CISTERN and takes about five minutes to swim, but does not state whether the tunnel rises, falls, or remains level.
The maps show a metal-door symbol between 41 SUNKEN SHRINE and 42 SUNKEN GALLERY, but the supplied room text does not identify its exact subtype or default state.
The maps show a metal-door symbol between 42 SUNKEN GALLERY and 43 SPIDER CRAB, but the supplied room text does not identify its exact subtype or default state.
The map shows a locked steel door east of 43 SPIDER CRAB, but the destination beyond that boundary is not identified on any supplied page.
Page 24 shows that 15 CRACK reaches a fist-sized opening overlooking the plaza and supports sight, speech, and exchange of small items, but it does not support person-sized traversal into the plaza.
Page 32 repeats the heading 25F CRYPT for two different moon phases, while the map distinctly labels rooms 25C and 25F. The node labels follow the map.
The ascending stairs behind the north steel doors at 5 LANDING are visible, but their destination is not named in this pack.
